title: Add live Linux gVisor runtime coverage
summary: Add opt-in live coverage for the linux-gvisor runtime path so daemon-selectable sandbox execution has real runsc validation without making default CI depend on Linux host setup.
expectedFailureModes: The live test runs by default on macOS or contributor machines without runsc and fails nondeterministically.
The live test exercises only OCI config construction and misses the actual runsc dispatch path.
A runsc failure leaks host-local paths or silently falls back to trusted-local execution.
The live coverage matrix claims sandbox runtime coverage without naming the required host prerequisites.
verification: cd agent-os && cargo test -p covenant-runtime -- --ignored live_
humanEscalation: Linux host with runsc and a minimal rootfs for live validation
nextAction: Add an ignored live_ test that skips clearly when runsc/rootfs prerequisites are absent and records the sandbox runtime surface in the live coverage matrix.
